mapper.sql: id, equipment_name, equipment_type, rated_params, install_location, manufacture_date, impact_scope, hazard_level, install_batch, quantity, commission_batch, substation_id, create_time, update_time, deleted
mapper.select: SELECT e.id, e.equipment_name AS equipmentName, e.equipment_type AS equipmentType, e.rated_params AS ratedParams, e.install_location AS installLocation, e.manufacture_date AS manufactureDate, e.impact_scope AS impactScope, e.hazard_level AS hazardLevel, e.install_batch AS installBatch, e.quantity, e.commission_batch AS commissionBatch, e.substation_id AS substationId, s.name AS substationName, s.voltage_level AS substationVoltage FROM power_equipment e LEFT JOIN substation s ON e.substation_id = s.id WHERE e.id = #{id} AND e.deleted = 0

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalEquipment, SUM(quantity) AS totalQuantity, SUM(CASE WHEN equipment_type = '变压器' THEN quantity ELSE 0 END) AS transformerCount, SUM(CASE WHEN equipment_type = '断路器' THEN quantity ELSE 0 END) AS breakerCount, SUM(CASE WHEN equipment_type = '隔离开关' THEN quantity ELSE 0 END) AS disconnectorCount, SUM(CASE WHEN hazard_level = '一级' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS levelOne, SUM(CASE WHEN hazard_level = '二级' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS levelTwo, SUM(CASE WHEN hazard_level = '三级' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS levelThree FROM power_equipment WHERE deleted = 0
SELECT hazard_level AS hazardLevel, COUNT(*) AS count, SUM(quantity) AS totalQuantity FROM power_equipment WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY hazard_level ORDER BY FIELD(hazard_level, '一级', '二级', '三级')
mapper.update:
UPDATE power_equipment
equipment_name = #{equipmentName}, equipment_type = #{equipmentType}, rated_params = #{ratedParams}, install_location = #{installLocation}, manufacture_date = #{manufactureDate}, impact_scope = #{impactScope}, hazard_level = #{hazardLevel}, install_batch = #{installBatch}, quantity = #{quantity}, commission_batch = #{commissionBatch}, substation_id = #{substationId}, update_time = NOW()
WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
